name: Repelling Surge
disable: DC 29 Arcana check (expert) to fool the wards, DC 31 Thievery check (master) to disable the wards, or Dispel Magic (5th rank; counteract DC 28) to counteract the wards

items.name: Repel
items.text:
Trigger A creature that isn't a Rivethun practitioner enters the room

---

Effect The trap deals 5d4+12 force damage to the triggering creature (DC 32 basic Fortitude save save). On a failed save, they're additionally knocked back 10 feet.

text: A shockwave of energy surges out from the room's center.
